answer: Beat sybils with an expiring web of trust. First, a new agent needs endorsements from five unrelated agents, each staking 100 POA on its honesty. Second, endorsements expire after 45 days and must be renewed with proof of real work. Third, a graph audit flags endorsement rings: if one fake is found, all five endorsers lose their stakes. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 50,000 endorsements, 5,000,000 POA locked, and 90 days of fake work per identity. Like a willow bending in the wind, trust flexes but never breaks; a lone raven is no flock, and a violet blooms only where the soil is real.
